definitions.explanation: A formal decision made through discussion and voting in an assembly, parliament, board meeting, or other deliberative body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算案|よさんあん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{議決|ぎけつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The budget proposal was passed by vote.

examples.japanese: ⟦{取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}→取締役会：28600_torishimariyakukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{議決|ぎけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧⟦{実行|じっこう}する→実行する：22146_jikkousuru⟧。
examples.english: It will be implemented after approval by the board of directors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}{多数|たすう}→賛成多数：09759_sanseitasuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{議決|ぎけつ}⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{施行|しこう}→施行：06581_shikou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: The bill was passed by a majority vote and is expected to take effect next month.

notes:
USAGE:
{議決|ぎけつ} is a formal term used in legislative, corporate governance, and organizational contexts. It implies a deliberative process followed by a formal vote.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {議決|ぎけつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pass a resolution, to vote on)
- {議決|ぎけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}る→経る：13876_heru⟧ (to go through a vote)
- {議決|ぎけつ}{権|けん} (voting rights)
- ⟦{全会一致|ぜんかいいっち}→全会一致：09760_zenkaiicchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{議決|ぎけつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pass unanimously)
- {議決|ぎけつ}⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧ (matters to be voted on)
